## MechWarrior 1 Remake 1.1.4

The Mac app is signed and notarized by Apple. Nothing in play changes.

- **On a Mac, the Remake opens like any other app:** the app and its download are signed with a Developer ID and notarized by Apple, so macOS no longer stops it the first time and there is no Open Anyway step.
- **The release's checksums are signed** (`SHA256SUMS.sig` beside `SHA256SUMS`), so the launcher can take the Remake from this project's mirror when GitHub cannot be reached.

Saved games are unchanged: 1.1.4 reads and writes the same saves as 1.1.3.

You still need your own copies of MechWarrior (1989), MechWarrior 3 and Pirate's Moon.
